data.narrative:
Terra Industries, a Seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by Nathan Nwachuku and Maxwell Maduka, has raised $34M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 10 comparable companies—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic—spanning Seed and Series A stages within the sector.

Two primary valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $34M raised as a value proxy and applies a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage step-ups, yielding $85M. Peer-median analysis examines five same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables with a median valuation of $1.0B and a range of $125M to $4.0B, directly implying $1.0B. The peer distribution reflects material dispersion: UFORCE at $1.0B (Seed) anchors the upper quartile, while NODA AI at $125M (Series A) represents the lower bound.

Triangulating these methods produces a low estimate of $72M (weighted toward stage-progression), a median of $542M, and a high of $1.1B (weighted toward peer medians). The wide range reflects two primary uncertainties: (1) the substantial valuation dispersion within the Defense & Security peer cohort, particularly across stage transitions, and (2) Terra Industries' positioning within that distribution relative to more mature funded peers. Additional clarity on product-market traction and customer pipeline would narrow this range materially.
